items.why: True on main at cba92837: the key rules run only on the picture layer and the focus holder is not focusable while loading (player-screen.tsx), and Viewing ignores seek and pause before the first frame (viewing-transport.test.ts). The frozen T8-04 item 5 cases of player-chrome.test.tsx hold the play-pause key. No existing Jest case presses a key on the screen while loading; the implementer adds that unfrozen guard.
The item is what DESIGN.md says; a documentation item is checked by review, never by a test.
Before and after captures in the PR are judged by eye in review.
